{"reason":"Add a market-signal-mismatch branch for demand-forecast-error and lower the positive-bias cutoff from 0.1 to 0.05. The eight shown failures have market-mismatch=#t or bias 0.065-0.081 and total 1,330,000, addressing v1's accuracy=0.708, unknown=23, and recovery-rate=0.607 while preserving supplier-delay precedence.","source":"(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((and (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
          (> (bias-amount expedite-event) 0.05))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    ((market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event)
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
